questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Guatemala?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Guatemala article.

questions.proof: To the northeast is the Caribbean Sea and Gulf of Honduras and its capital and largest city is Guatemala City.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Guatemala?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Guatemala on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Guatemala article.

questions.proof: It borders Mexico, Belize, Honduras, and El Salvador.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Guatemala?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Population” part of the Guatemala article.

questions.proof: Native Mayan people are 49% of the population, while 9% are direct descendants of Spanish and German people.
